editorial:
You know that feeling when a perfect romance suddenly crashes? That is where this comedy starts. Carly thinks she has found a great guy, only to learn he is married. Then she meets his wife, Kate, and the two women form an unlikely bond. Soon they discover a third woman, Amber, and the trio decides to team up. The vibe is loud, silly, and revenge-focused, with friendship growing out of betrayal. It is not deep, but it moves quickly and keeps the jokes coming for a fun weekend watch.

Cameron Diaz, Leslie Mann, and Kate Upton bring big energy, and Leslie Mann especially steals scenes with nervous, funny reactions. The revenge plans are cartoonish, and some jokes miss, but the chemistry keeps it fun. If you want a light girls-night movie, this works well. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the women expose Mark's cheating and business fraud, using the evidence to turn his own company against him. Kate takes control of the business, Mark is arrested, and the three women celebrate their freedom and friendship. Carly also finds a healthier new romance, while Kate steps into a stronger, happier life after leaving the marriage behind for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves female-led comedies and revenge plots.
